mapper.select: SELECT ju.JOBSEEKER_NAME AS jobSeekerName, cp.KEYSKILL AS keySkill, cm.COM_MATCH_SCORE AS comMatchScore, cm.COM_AI_REASON AS comAiReason, DATE_FORMAT(cm.MATCHING_CREATEAT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS matchingCreatedAt, cm.JOB_POSTS_IDX AS jobPostsIdx, cm.JOBSEEKER_IDX AS jobSeekerIdx FROM company_matching cm LEFT JOIN jobseeker_users ju ON ju.JOBSEEKER_IDX = cm.JOBSEEKER_IDX LEFT JOIN job_posts jp ON jp.JOB_POSTS_IDX = cm.JOB_POSTS_IDX LEFT JOIN cover_posts cp ON cp.JOBSEEKER_IDX = ju.JOBSEEKER_IDX WHERE cm.JOB_POSTS_IDX = #{jobPostsIdx} ORDER BY cm.COM_MATCH_SCORE DESC LIMIT 20;
